Rishi — pulling the current published hosted ratecard. Below are the standard list prices (per 1M tokens), input / output split and standard volume tiers. These are list prices; committed (reserved) contracts get additional concessions subject to Sales Ops approval.

Standard hosted list prices (per 1M tokens):
- Redwood-1-small: $0.80 / $1.20
- Redwood-1-medium: $1.40 / $2.10
- Redwood-1-large: $2.40 / $3.60
- Redwood-Instruction (earthlighter tuning): $1.80 / $2.70
- Llama2-70B-hosted (opt): $1.50 / $2.25
- Mistral-Instruct: $1.00 / $1.60
- Embeddings (per 1M tokens equivalent): $0.50 (flat)

Volume discounts (applied to list price):
- >50M/mo: 10% off
- >200M/mo: 18% off
- >500M/mo: 25% off

Committed annual discounts: standard additional 5% off for a 12-month minimum committed spend (applies after volume discount). Maximum stacking cap: volume discount + committed discount can be combined, but total discount cannot exceed 30% without VP sign-off.

Notes:
- Input vs output: we bill prompt (input) and completion (output) separately — use the split above.
- Egress: standard cloud egress charges apply and are not included in token pricing; we note egress estimates for large media payloads.
- Storage for KV/prefix cache: billed separately; we usually include a small monthly allowance for hosted customers.
- Reserved/Dedicated: Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) pricing is quoted separately (usually lower per-token economics at large commits) and includes SLA options.

I’ll attach the April ratecard PDF for Rishi to send. If Clearsight is requesting a 20% committed discount for 12 months on 200M tokens/mo, that’s within reach if we combine the 18% volume tier + 5% committed = 23% (but note cap rules — we might need VP approval for >20% discount on a new customer).

Marissa
VP, Pricing & Packaging
